info.title: Qminder API
info.description: The Qminder API allows you to integrate queue management into your own applications.

DaySchedule.description: Schedule for a single day. Either set businessHours or closed.

businessHours.description: Time ranges when the location is open.

closed.description: If true, the location is closed this day.

TimeRange.description: A time range with opening and closing times.

LocationInputField.description: An input field to create with the location. Uses the same schema as POST /input-fields, but without `location` (auto-set) and `visibleForLines` (lines don't exist yet).

id.description: Client-generated UUID for the input field.

title.description: Display title. Required for TEXT, SELECT, URL, DATE, and NUMERIC types.

isMandatoryBeforeAdded.description: Must be filled before ticket is added.

isMandatoryBeforeServed.description: Must be filled before ticket is served.

isMandatoryInRemoteSignIn.description: Must be filled in remote sign-in.

showInRemoteSignIn.description: Show in remote sign-in. Always treated as false for URL fields.

visitorFacingTitle.description: Title shown to visitors. Available for TEXT, SELECT, DATE, and NUMERIC types.

multiSelect.description: Allow multiple selections. Required for SELECT type.

options.description: Select options. Required for SELECT type.

constraints.description: Numeric constraints. Available for NUMERIC type.

translations.description: Translations. Available for TEXT, SELECT, URL, DATE, and NUMERIC types. Referenced language codes must be included in the location's languages field.

isRequiredInAppointments.description: Whether required in appointments. Available for LAST_NAME and EMAIL types.

LineRequest.description: A line (service) to create with the location.

disabled.description: Whether the line starts disabled (default: false).

translations.description: Name translations for multi-language support. Referenced language codes must be included in the location's languages field.

LineTranslationRequest.description: A name translation for a line.

name.description: Translated line name (max 30 characters). Can be null as a placeholder.

post.description: Creates a new location in the account.

parameters.name: X-Qminder-API-Version
parameters.description: API version. Must be set to `2020-09-01`.

languages.description: Languages available at this location. An array of ISO 639 / BCP 47 language codes (e.g. "en", "et", "fr-CA"). Must include "en". No duplicates allowed. Order is preserved. Defaults to ["en"] if omitted.

inputFields.description: Custom input fields to create with the location. If omitted, three default fields are created (first name, last name, phone number). Must include at least one FIRST_NAME and one LAST_NAME field. Each field uses the same schema as POST /input-fields, but without location and visibleForLines.

lines.description: Custom lines (queues) to create with the location. If omitted, two default lines are created ("Main Service" and "Information"). Uses the same schema as POST /locations/{id}/lines, but without appointmentSettings.

openingHours.description: Opening hours configuration. If omitted, the location defaults to 24/7 (00:00–23:59 every day).

regular.description: Weekly schedule with keys: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun.

closed.description: If true, the location is closed on this date.

example.name: SF City Hall
example.address: 1 Dr Carlton B Goodlett Pl, San Francisco, CA 94102, United States

id.description: The ID of the created location.

code-samples.code:
curl -X POST https://api.qminder.com/locations \
  -H "X-Qminder-REST-API-Key: KEY" \
  -H "X-Qminder-API-Version: 2020-09-01" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "SF City Hall",
    "latitude": 37.7792792,
    "longitude": -122.4214304,
    "address": "1 Dr Carlton B Goodlett Pl, San Francisco, CA 94102, United States",
    "country": "US"
  }'

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Search tickets only in the given Location.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Search tickets with only the given status. Multiple statuses can be searched by separating them with a comma. "NEW" will return tickets that are in queue, and have not been called. "CALLED" will return tickets that are currently being served. "SERVED" will return tickets that have been served. "CANCELLED_BY_CLERK" will return tickets that have been removed from queue.

parameters.name: caller
parameters.description: Search tickets that have been called by the given user ID. Both "CALLED" and "SERVED" tickets will be returned, unless status is also specified.

parameters.name: minCreated
parameters.description: Search tickets which have been created after the given timestamp. The timestamp can be in ISO 8601 format, eg "2020-05-03T00:00:00Z". Alternatively, the timestamp can be a Unix timestamp, eg 1588767798.

parameters.name: maxCreated
parameters.description: Search tickets which have been created before the given timestamp. The timestamp can be in ISO 8601 format, eg "2020-05-03T00:00:00Z". Alternatively, the timestamp can be a Unix timestamp, eg 1588767798.

parameters.name: minCalled
parameters.description: Search tickets which have been called after the given timestamp. The timestamp can be in ISO 8601 format, eg "2020-05-03T00:00:00Z". Alternatively, the timestamp can be a Unix timestamp, eg 1588767798.

parameters.name: maxCalled
parameters.description: Search tickets which have been called before the given timestamp. The timestamp can be in ISO 8601 format, eg "2020-05-03T00:00:00Z". Alternatively, the timestamp can be a Unix timestamp, eg 1588767798.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit search results to the specified amount of tickets. With a limit of 100, only the 100 first results will be returned. The limit has to be between 1 and 20000.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Order search results according to a ticket parameter. Order is specified using two words in one string, for example "id ASC". Valid order directions: ASC, DESC Valid ordering parameters: id, created, called, served

parameters.name: responseScope
parameters.description: Include additional data in the search results. Use multiple response scopes by separating them with a comma. Valid response scopes are: "MESSAGES" - include SMS messages with the response "INTERACTIONS" - include interaction data with the response "CONNECTED_TICKETS" - include connected tickets (other visits of the same person)
